INTRO_KR: Since 1977, Pierre Lannier is proud to style the wrist with French style and elegance. 48 years of history promoting French watchmaker know-how and the "French Elegance". 48 years of successful and unique craftmanship and reflection of the watch industry evolution. The Pierre Lannier brand has its origins in Alsace, France. Founded in 1977 by the Burgun family, it is now run by the second & third generations: Pierre Burgun and his daughter, Laura. Strong traditional values coupled with sense of product, creativity & willingness to promote the French Savoir Faire, the Burgun family continuously innovate, elevate the brand & its watch collections. Since the beginning in their owned workshop in Alsace, designers and watchmakers combined their know-how and their passion to create hand-assembled distinctive timepieces. Every day, the head watchmaker, and his team, are meticulously assembling the watches with precision and technique, anchored in the French watchmaker tradition. A real commitment to focus on high quality expectations and the ability to sign the collection ‘Made in France’.

INTRO_KR: Since its creation in 1908, the family company ROCHET GROUP (Annecy, France), owner of the ROCHET and BOUVERET brands, has been designing, manufacturing and distributing watch straps for watch brands and jewelers. Inventor of the expansion metal watchband in 1917, the brand has since widely diversified its range of synthetic and especially leather watch bracelets, which now account for 85% of sales. With over a million watchstraps sold each year, and nearly 4,000 retailers worldwide, ROCHET GROUP is the undisputed leader in France, and has an international presence in over 45 countries, with its own subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Japan and Belgium. With an advanced logistics center integrated into its Annecy headquarters, ROCHET GROUP also has its own 100% French unit production, ROCHET BOUVERET MANUFACTURE in Besan?on, producing over 30,000 top of the range taylor made straps a year, in exceptional skins.
